definitions.explanation: The place or area where one is assigned to work or stand guard. Also refers to one's area of responsibility.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧{持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ろう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: Let's each do our best at our own posts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: Even in an emergency, you must not leave your post.

notes:
{持|も}ち{場|ば} refers to one's assigned position or area of responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (stay at one's post)
- {持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (return to one's post)
- {持|も}ち{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ (leave one's post)
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{場|ば} (each person's position)

USAGE NOTE: Often used in workplace, military, or event contexts where people have assigned positions.
